cycle1Checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored; Orbit Duel selected, Gravity Flip Runner as fallback.
Single-file HTML5 canvas architecture, tunable constants, testing plan defined.
Self-contained playable prototype: 2-player local gravity-duel arcade game, no build step, no external assets/deps.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium smoke tests: load+interaction test and ~6s extended-session test, both PASS. Found and fixed one test-hook staleness bug (window.__orbitDuel.bullets snapshot vs live getter) during testing. Win-condition end-to-end and fun/balance tuning are NOT covered by automated tests -- flagged as follow-up.

checkpoints.notes: 5 new concepts brainstormed and scored (no repeats of Cycle 1 candidates); Echo Maze selected, Pulse Runner as fallback.

Single-file HTML5 canvas architecture for Echo Maze: fixed hand-authored maze, BFS-based ping/fog system, scripted guard patrol, grid-cell collision for win/lose, tunable constants, testing plan defined.

Self-contained playable prototype: single-player stealth-navigation game with sound-pulse fog-of-war, scripted guard patrols, and grid-cell win/lose detection. Maze layout, start/exit cells, and guard patrol paths generated once by a seeded offline script (not committed -- a one-off generation aid) and hardcoded into the shipped HTML file for a guaranteed-solvable, deterministic level. No build step, no external assets/deps.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium tests: load+movement+ping/fog+patrol smoke test, directed win-condition test, directed lose-condition test, restart test, and an extended mixed-input stress test -- all 5 PASS, zero errors. Win condition exercised via a test-only teleport hook rather than scripting the full ~40-step solution path with real input; win/lose primitives and real movement/ping/patrol systems are otherwise directly verified. Fun/balance tuning not human-playtested -- flagged as follow-up, consistent with Cycle 1's approach.
